resources.string: Agents can\'t ask for anything that needs a wallet until you connect one. This app doesn\'t create a wallet and never sees your seed phrase or keys: it asks the wallet app you already use, and keeps only the address you pick.
This phone has more than one wallet app. Pick the one to connect: approvals will open it directly, and never ask you to choose again.
Approvals open this app directly, without asking again.
This app never sees your seed phrase or keys. It asks the wallet you already use, and keeps only the address you pick.
The wallet didn\'t list this network for the account. It may refuse to sign on it.
No connections yet, so there\'s no sidecar to tell.
That server still has the previous address. Until it hears, its requests will name the wrong wallet.
No wallet app answered. Install or set up a wallet that supports Mobile Wallet Adapter, such as Seed Vault Wallet on the Seeker.
The wallet didn\'t give an account. Nothing changed.
The wallet no longer accepts this app\'s authorization. Connect again to approve it afresh.
The wallet doesn\'t serve this network. Pick another one.
This phone couldn\'t store the wallet\'s authorization, so nothing was saved.
The wallet couldn\'t complete the request.
Add the wallet accounts you want connections to use. Each connection signs with the one you choose for it, on the network its server supports. This app never sees your seed phrase or keys.
Your wallet asks which account to authorize. Adding the same account on another network makes a separate profile.
The wallet no longer accepts this profile\'s authorization. Reconnect it to sign again; its connections keep it.
No connection uses this wallet. It is removed from this phone only.

These connections use it and will be left without a wallet until you choose one: %1$s. Direct servers are told there is no wallet, which cancels their pending requests. Nothing is chosen in its place, and your history is kept.
The wallet didn\'t authorize this profile\'s account, so nothing changed.
This connection signs only with this wallet, on this network.
No wallet chosen. Nothing from this server can be signed until you choose one.
Its wallet was removed. Choose another to sign again.
The wallet no longer accepts this profile\'s authorization. Reconnect it on the Wallets screen.
This server hasn\'t declared which Solana networks it supports. Nothing from it can be signed until it is updated to declare them.
This server no longer supports %1$s. Choose a wallet on %2$s — the connection isn\'t moved for you.
Telling the server about this wallet. Nothing is signed until it confirms.
%1$s only · switch it on the Wallet tab
This server supports %1$s. Only wallets on those networks are shown.
This server hasn\'t declared any Solana network. You can still choose a wallet — a restricted feed proves who you are with it — but nothing is signed until the server declares one.
No saved wallet is on a network this server supports.
Changing the wallet tells this server only. It cancels its pending requests made for the previous wallet.
Changing the wallet drops anything prepared for the previous one; signals are prepared again for the new wallet.
The server now uses this wallet.
